item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:45 HKT 06/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong today. It will be cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night over inland areas will be rather large. An easterly airstream will also affect the coast of Guangdong gradually today. It will be windy and slightly cloudier over the region in the following couple of days. A surge of the winter monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China on Thursday. It will become cold over the region.
